claims.claim: Enovix reported Q2 2026 revenue of $9.0M, up 21% year over year, and first-half revenue of $16.6M, up 32%; smart-eyewear cells completed key safety certifications and approximately 2,100 AI-1 batteries shipped in Q2 with initial product revenue recognized.

A lead smartphone customer confirmed more than 1,000 cycles under a 0.2C discharge test while final accelerated cycle-life qualification remained underway; drone opportunities exceeded $100M in Q2 and the drone battery subsequently passed UN 38.3 transportation testing.

risks.risk: Commercial revenue remains small relative to the scale implied by smartphone and drone opportunity claims, and final smartphone qualification was not complete at the reporting date.

unknowns.unknown: Customer identities, firm purchase commitments and conversion timing for much of the opportunity pipeline remain undisclosed.

claims.claim: Certification completion, first smart-eyewear product revenue and physical shipments are concrete commercialization steps, but the smartphone program remains a qualification-stage expectation rather than proven scaled revenue.

risks.risk: Qualification delays, yield/manufacturing scale-up or customer program changes could prevent pipeline conversion despite technical milestones.

unknowns.unknown: The source does not establish high-volume manufacturing yield or smartphone production award economics.
